spec_anchor: WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json IMP-0074: typed registry API contract with a strict-parser conformance surface

evidence.claim: The lenient reference client accepts every recorded success and error case in the 18-row matrix (index, plugin list with limit/cursor pagination, get, search, structured 400/404 errors, tolerated unknown query keys).

A strict third-party client built from the contract FILE ALONE (no api/clients import) accepts every recorded success fixture, rejects a missing required field and an undocumented extra field, and distinguishes truncated pagination from an empty unmatched search - so the contract does not depend on lenient parsing.

controls.description: Dropping the required 'description' from a valid plugin_response must fail BOTH the lenient and the strict walker.
controls.bad: missing required field description (both clients reject)
controls.good: untouched plugin_response validates clean for both

controls.description: Adding undocumented_bonus to a plugin must leave the lenient reference client green while the strict client rejects it - the extra field discriminates the two parsers.
controls.good: lenient accepts the same mutated body

controls.description: A limit=2 page is truncated (next_cursor present) while an unmatched search is empty with NO cursor - pagination is distinguishable from emptiness.
controls.good: page1 next_cursor present; unmatched search empty without cursor

residuals.claim: Live .claude-plugin/marketplace.json is not on this worktree; conformance runs against the fixture index. The contract is the API, not a second index file.
residuals.settling_experiment: Re-run conformance against a real IMP-0067 index once that artifact exists on disk.

reviewer.scope: Built a minimal third-party client from the contract file alone (no api/clients import) and re-ran the whole matrix through it; reports 3 ambiguities a third party cannot resolve from the contract (cursor opacity, unknown-query-key tolerance, search matching semantics).
reviewer.notes: Reviewer obligation (catalog) satisfied: strict client from contract alone + ambiguity report.

report: G-1 for IMP-0074: registry API contract built (schema + typed api + reference/strict clients + fixture index + 10-test suite all green); 18-row reference matrix accepted; contract-alone strict client passes successes and discriminates mutations; receipt closed SUCCESS by the probe2 instrument after a BLOCKED/reviewer-absent builder phase.
